instructions.reports: Ask the research assistant to backtest a strategy first, then open its results here. Download PDFs and other chat-generated documents from the original conversation.
instructions.portfolio: Add and enable an account source, then refresh its holdings. This page provides a read-only account overview.
instructions.alphaZoo: Read a factor definition, then choose a market and date range to evaluate or compare signals. Validate candidates with a backtest.
instructions.optionsLab: Choose a preset or add option legs, then adjust price, expiry, and volatility; results update automatically. The stock symbol for the live chain is separate from the simulation inputs.
instructions.correlation: Enter at least two asset symbols, choose a lookback window, then select Compute.
instructions.settings: Local execution and API connection. No model configuration is required.
instructions.workbench: The service snapshots only the files explicitly listed in your manifest. Run from the repository root; see README for the artifact contract.
instructions.compare: Select two completed experiments in the workbench.

alphaZoo.title: Alpha Zoo
alphaZoo.browseDesc: Browse formula-driven cross-sectional signals from Qlib, the Kakushadze 101 set, GTJA 191, the academic anomaly literature, and PIT-safe fundamentals. Click any alpha to read its formula and source code, or run a bench to score the whole zoo on a universe and period.
alphaZoo.noAlphasMatch: No alphas match the current filters.
alphaZoo.scoreZoo: Score a zoo on a universe
alphaZoo.scoreDesc: Computes IC / IR for every alpha in the selected zoo over the chosen universe and period, then bucketizes them as alive / reversed / dead.
alphaZoo.compareDesc: Benches just the alphas you pick on a universe and period, then ranks them by IC / IR with the gap to the leader — far faster than benching a whole zoo when you only care about a shortlist.
alphaZoo.alphaIdsHint: Separate ids with commas or spaces. Tip: tick alphas in the catalogue and hit "Compare" to prefill this.
alphaZoo.enterAtLeast2: Enter at least 2 distinct alpha ids to compare.
alphaZoo.icPositiveTitle: Share of periods with positive IC
alphaZoo.predictiveHalfLifeTitle: Predictive half-life: trading days before the signal's edge decays

zooCardDesc.qlib158: Microsoft Qlib's full 158-feature library covering momentum, volatility, volume and rolling statistical signals.
zooCardDesc.alpha101: The 101 formulaic alphas from Kakushadze (2015); short-horizon cross-sectional signals.
zooCardDesc.gtja191: Guotai Junan Securities' 191 alphas; technical and microstructure signals tuned to China A-share markets.
zooCardDesc.academic: Curated long-horizon anomalies from the academic literature (value, momentum, quality, low-vol, etc.).
zooCardDesc.fundamental: Quality and value factors computed from PIT-safe SEC company facts — earnings yield, ROE, gross profitability, asset growth (filed-date anchored).

gloss.total_return: How much the strategy gained or lost over the full test period.
gloss.annual_return: The strategy's return scaled to a typical one-year period.
gloss.sharpe: Return earned per unit of total risk, where higher is generally better.
gloss.max_drawdown: The largest peak-to-trough loss during the test period.
gloss.win_rate: The share of completed trades that made a profit.
gloss.trade_count: The number of trades completed during the test period.
gloss.calmar: Annual return divided by maximum drawdown, balancing growth against worst loss.
gloss.sortino: Return earned per unit of downside risk, where higher is generally better.
gloss.profit_loss_ratio: The average winning trade compared with the average losing trade.
gloss.max_consecutive_loss: The longest run of losing trades in a row.
gloss.benchmark_return: The return of the comparison benchmark over the same period.
gloss.excess_return: How much the strategy outperformed or underperformed its benchmark.
gloss.information_ratio: Excess return earned per unit of tracking error against the benchmark.
gloss.final_value: The portfolio value at the end of the test period.
gloss.avg_holding_days: The average number of days each position stayed open.
